extensionDescription.message: Block unsolicited pop-ups and intrusive overlays. Local processing, no tracking or data collection.

unsupportedPage.description: Shown for internal or restricted pages.

protectionAllowed.description: Protection disabled by an exact-host exception.

protectionActive.description: Protection is enabled on the current site.

popupsBlockedOne.description: Counter for exactly one blocked pop-up.

popupsBlockedMany.description: Counter for zero or more than one blocked pop-up.

overlaysHiddenOne.description: Counter for exactly one hidden overlay.

overlaysHiddenMany.description: Counter for zero or more than one hidden overlay.

settingsNote.message: Global settings apply unless this site has an exception.

protectionSettings.description: Accessible label for the settings section.

allowSite.description: Site exception switch and notification action.

rememberSelections.description: Optional persistence of selected CSS selectors.

pickerHelp.message: Shift + click to keep selecting. Esc to exit.
pickerHelp.description: Keyboard instructions for the element picker.

restoreHelp.message: Hidden elements can always be restored.

dataSummary.description: Counts of stored exceptions and saved selectors.

privacySummary.message: Only settings, site exceptions and saved selectors are stored. No browsing history, page content or tracking identifiers.

actionUnavailable.message: Action unavailable. Reload the page and try again.

savedApplied.message: Saved and applied to open pages.

savedReloadOne.message: Saved. $COUNT$ tab could not be updated. Reload that tab.
savedReloadOne.description: One tab needs a manual reload.

savedReloadMany.message: Saved. $COUNT$ tabs could not be updated. Reload those tabs.
savedReloadMany.description: Several tabs need a manual reload.

noticeRegion.message: Pop-up blocked by Clear Pop Up
noticeRegion.description: Accessible region name for the first-block notice.

noticeBlocked.description: Blocked source hostname, treated as text.

noticeHint.message: This exception applies only to Clear Pop Up. Chrome and other blockers operate independently. No window will be reopened automatically.
noticeHint.description: Explains the scope and behavior of the allow action.

keepBlocked.description: Dismiss without allowing the source site.

allowFailed.message: Could not allow this site. Reload the page and try again.

siteAllowedReload.message: $HOST$ is allowed. Reload the page to try the intended pop-up again.
siteAllowedReload.description: Allow-site success with the exact hostname.

removeExceptionHint.message: You can remove this exception from the Clear Pop Up toolbar icon.
removeExceptionHint.description: Explains how to reverse the exception.

protectionOffOnSite.message: Protection is off on this site.
protectionOffOnSite.description: Picker cannot start on an unprotected site.
